title: Warm attachment is a premise of the burden, not a mask concealing a wholly loveless home
support: The dinner, handmade supplies, gifts, patient homecoming, and resumed conversation show affection operating before and after the crisis. The burden matters partly because she genuinely values those people.
counterevidence_and_limits: Encouragement can still constrain. The bag description explicitly includes constraint, and she hides fatigue. Warmth does not make all parental pressure harmless.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Sustained primary scenes of affection being deliberately withdrawn for ordinary failure would require revising the family mechanism, rather than merely adding a harsh line from a nightmare.

title: Rune aptitude is exceptional but domain-limited
scope: Archive formation, institutional examination, later study
support: She can manifest rune meaning without fully understanding its origin; the blessing does not grant total comprehension. Later science tutoring remains necessary.
counterevidence_and_limits: Domain limits do not mean poor general intelligence or inability to learn. She can tutor others and contribute uncommon spatial insights.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A later explicit expansion of her ability could update the later-state model. It would not retroactively make early uncertainty fictitious.

title: Success can deepen her aversion to error
scope: The Exoswarm event and competitive memories
support: The intervention succeeds through prior preparation and assistance even though the final rune fails. The frightening margin can become an inward demand never to err; winning also generates pressure to keep winning.
counterevidence_and_limits: The rescue has real stakes, so caution is not simply irrational vanity. Not every success demonstrably worsens her state.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Repeated comparable early successes accompanied by relaxed acceptance of margins would weaken the proposed feedback pattern; a source explaining a wholly different cause of the fear would narrow its explanatory reach.

title: Her early standard confuses responsibility for effort with responsibility for every outcome
scope: Student pressure through the central crisis
support: The diary moves from difficulty to necessity because she is Sigrika, while imagined failure endangers both companions and identity. The final speech revises what holding expectations means.
counterevidence_and_limits: She is actually responsible for some decisions and risks. The model must not turn accountability into something she merely imagines.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Evidence that she already consistently distinguishes limited responsibility from guaranteed success before the crisis would force a narrower or different developmental account.

title: The school is both a pressure-producing setting and a source of care
support: Unfamiliar coursework and exceptional reputation intensify strain; counseling, protective intervention, teaching, and responsive adult support are also present.
counterevidence_and_limits: Care does not prove the institution has no systemic problem. The evidence is not a complete policy or student-outcome audit.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A broader primary institutional corpus might expose practices absent here. It could revise the balance without deleting the care scenes.

title: The rigged judgment cannot be reduced to her psychological failure
scope: Dark Side second investigation and wider operation
support: The raw outline says any answer is judged wrong at the crisis point. Antagonist and authority context establishes manipulation beyond her own insecurity.
counterevidence_and_limits: Her emotional material helps shape the trap. External manipulation and inward pressure are simultaneous causes, not competing all-or-nothing explanations.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A source-level correction that the judgment was objectively answerable would alter the mechanism. Her statement that she shaped it does not by itself establish such a correction.

title: Reflections are evidence of a threatening representation, not direct access to real peers’ minds
support: The mother/friend projections exaggerate pressure, and the counterpart is explicitly separate from direct Sigrika. Later actual support supplies counterweights.
counterevidence_and_limits: Some reflected concerns may overlap with real history; representation is not synonymous with complete fabrication.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Independent real-world scenes corroborating a specific accusation can establish that accusation separately. They cannot license wholesale acceptance of every reflected claim.

title: Alia exposes the limits of exhorting another person to meet expectations
support: Sigrika recognizes fear and responsibility yet cannot settle Alia’s dilemma by repeating her own standard. Shared feeling does not make an answer transferable.
counterevidence_and_limits: A single unsuccessful reassurance does not show that all her emotional support is ineffective.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Later evidence of an explicit, repeatable technique would refine her support capacity, while preserving the observed early limitation.

title: The counterpart uses genuine vulnerabilities without becoming her authentic total self
support: She admits having questioned expectations and wanted escape, then rejects the interlocutor’s interpretation of her feelings and effort. Admission and refusal coexist.
counterevidence_and_limits: Calling the counterpart merely alien would erase the recognized thoughts. Calling it simply her true self would erase her direct refusal and the source identity boundary.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A later authoritative narrative reclassification would require a lore revision. A resonant line spoken by the counterpart alone is not that reclassification.

title: Her final choice changes the criterion for honoring expectations
scope: Final Dark Side decision and aftermath
support: The Chinese gold line links retaining expectations to deciding to act; later refusal of excess tasks and revised scheduling show consequences beyond a declaration.
counterevidence_and_limits: She still wants to do well and meet hopes. The English rendering stresses continued forward movement; neither witness guarantees success.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A sustained later pattern in which she explicitly treats any imperfect outcome as total moral failure would challenge the depth or durability of the change.

title: The text does not support a permanent do-whatever-I-want ethic
support: Chinese says this time where English says from now on. Later archive and work still affirm chosen obligations and practical assistance.
counterevidence_and_limits: The scene does establish real refusal of imposed interpretation. Narrowing the tense must not drain that refusal of force.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Later unambiguous renunciation of all other-directed obligations would alter the later model; a single English expansion cannot carry that conclusion against the broader corpus.

title: Help becomes compatible with a decision she must make herself
scope: Post-nightmare talk, final entry, and shared rescue
support: Rover does not supply the correct answer but offers assistance. Sigrika asks to be awakened if lost; later work distributes expertise rather than restoring solitary omnipotence.
counterevidence_and_limits: The self-reliance sentence is not identical across languages. The model describes a scene-supported distinction, not a universal ethical theorem in four equal wordings.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Evidence that her later choices are consistently delegated to Rover, or that she rejects all aid as illegitimate, would require major revision.

title: Courage is action with recognized uncertainty, not absence of fear
support: She weighs whether entering aids the trap and whether abstaining abandons people; she still asks for help if the nightmare recurs.
counterevidence_and_limits: Some combat lines sound categorical because their trigger and dramatic function differ. They do not measure private fear continuously.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A source explicitly removing the relevant uncertainty before she chooses would require describing that particular action as informed confidence instead.

title: Her rescue role is specialized and reciprocal
scope: Chisa rescue and later reactor-related work
support: Rune/spatial interpretation complements Chisa’s rescue capacity, other students’ logistics, Mornye’s projection, and Rover’s interpretation.
counterevidence_and_limits: She is more than an interchangeable helper. Her rare contribution can be indispensable in a scene without making all other contributions hers.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A fuller primary sequence assigning a claimed contribution to a different actor would require correcting the allocation, not simply calling everyone a collective hero.

title: Rest progresses from tolerated recovery toward an activity she can choose
scope: Gated cooperation episodes and later ordinary life
support: The rooftop begins as refuge and becomes a site of shared joy; rhythm play redirects attention, while written nonurgent work is replaced with rest.
counterevidence_and_limits: Some leisure still restores capacity for work. The text need not prove that every activity is free of instrumental benefit.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Evidence that all later leisure is coerced, or that she regards it only as a brief efficiency technique, would narrow the claim.

title: Declining requests is a stronger behavioral marker than a motivational slogan
support: She reports trying to decline unmanageable tasks, and the diary contains visible textual changes toward rest. Two different surfaces support revised limits.
counterevidence_and_limits: These are a report and narrated written evidence, not a long-term time-use study. The Korean line is more prospective than the Chinese.
revision_or_falsification_condition: An explicit later admission that the refusals never occurred would revise the behavioral claim; ordinary future strain would not automatically negate a demonstrated attempt.

title: Protective reassurance can impoverish the relationship it tries to protect
support: She explains that repeatedly saying she was fine left less to talk about. Later detailed conversation and the homecoming restore a fuller self to the relationship.
counterevidence_and_limits: She is not shown lying maliciously or being forbidden to speak. Nor does a successful conversation prove every family tension resolved.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Primary evidence of the mother punishing disclosure, or a different explicit account of why conversation dwindled, would change the mechanism.

title: Her mother’s response revises an expectation rather than creating attachment from nothing
support: The unexpected acknowledgment of her burden lands within an already loved home. What changes is what she can tell that home, not whether love ever existed.
counterevidence_and_limits: The surprise reveals a real prior gap in communication. Earlier warmth should not be used to trivialize her isolation.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A source identifying earlier family affection as deliberate performance would require a substantially different reading.

title: Birdwatching is an ordinary preference before it is a symbol
support: She has knowledge, failed photographs, a favorite place, film interest, invitations, and excitement about unfamiliar birds. The evidence supports activity-specific pleasure.
counterevidence_and_limits: The source also explicitly links birds with freedom and hope. Refusing total symbolism does not require refusing every metaphor.
revision_or_falsification_condition: If a claimed episode is only a promotional illustration or a counterfactual, its behavioral use must be withdrawn. Repeated direct activity presently supports the preference.

title: A single failed photograph is not proof that she is generally incompetent
support: She can learn unfamiliar rental controls and collaborate with a photographer while repeatedly missing birds’ faces. Different tasks have different skill demands.
counterevidence_and_limits: The comic failures are real limits; the model should not upgrade her to expert wildlife photographer.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A substantive later photography portfolio could raise that capability. The award scene alone, partly photographed by Rover, cannot.

title: The award scene limits a totalizing nature philosophy
support: The narration explicitly calls the judges’ elaborate reading excessive and identifies a simple wish to share luck and happiness.
counterevidence_and_limits: The photographs may still invite interpretation and circulate meaning beyond intention. The source does not ban interpretation in general.
revision_or_falsification_condition: An explicit later self-authored ecological doctrine would supply a separate basis; it should not be backdated into this simple wish.

title: Food preferences are specific, playful, and capable of contradicting a generic label
support: Fruit Crackle, Smoked Meat Stew, orange-related preference, and the strong Grilled Fern Spore aversion form a concrete everyday profile. The not-picky caption is too broad to erase the aversion.
counterevidence_and_limits: The corpus does not supply a complete diet, every favorite dish, or nutritional requirements. Candy enthusiasm is not addiction.
revision_or_falsification_condition: New explicit preferences can extend the profile. A source correction to a particular food translation should update the relevant label only.

title: Improvisation is possible even for someone anxious about correctness
scope: Her specially prepared candy and gift-making
support: The food-item description says she departs from recipe order and obtains a good result. The crooked folded cat is valued for effort, not perfection.
counterevidence_and_limits: These are small successful cases, not proof she is equally comfortable improvising under lethal stakes.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Repeated low-stakes refusal to deviate accompanied by repudiation of these experiments would weaken the generalization; one high-risk hesitation would not.

title: She gives practical and personally chosen forms of care
scope: Gifts, teaching, clinic collaboration, and food
support: Tutoring, homemade or selected gifts, rune assistance, shared sweets, and concrete appreciation of counseling show action-specific care rather than only benevolent sentiment.
counterevidence_and_limits: The birthday voice line is an addressed archive performance, not a dated observed gift exchange in the quest chronology.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A proposed care behavior absent from these source classes should remain an untested prediction, not be added to the ledger as if observed.

title: A playful care gesture can cross a boundary
confidence: high for the branch; bounded evaluation
support: The candy interaction can override Rover’s hesitation/refusal. As an evaluative reading, that limits any claim that her warmth always entails immaculate respect for another’s immediate choice.
counterevidence_and_limits: It is comic, low-stakes, and branch-conditioned. It does not justify recasting her as broadly coercive or malicious.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A corrected raw branch mapping showing no such override would remove the claim; a separate consent-respecting scene would qualify rather than erase this one.

title: Closeness with Rover does not license an exclusive romantic identity
support: The source supports trust, affection, cultural hospitality, and highly valued companionship. It does not explicitly establish exclusivity or a relationship contract.
counterevidence_and_limits: Affectionate and potentially romantic framing may be possible interpretations. They remain interpretations pending stronger evidence.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Explicit primary confirmation of a romantic relationship would update the appropriate state; voice timbre, a gift, or a culturally framed hug alone is insufficient.

title: She notices the contradiction in Denia’s escape rhetoric
scope: Archive observations and shared school life
support: Sigrika observes that Denia stays beside her when she studies late despite advocating escape. She therefore does not simply absorb Denia’s stated philosophy.
counterevidence_and_limits: She cannot fully explain Denia’s motives or origin, and admits as much. Perception of one contradiction is not mind-reading.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A source showing the stay-behind behavior did not occur, or that Sigrika’s account was knowingly fabricated, would require revision.

title: The birthday exchange demonstrates active perception, not blank innocence
support: She enumerates unusual actions—invitation, photographs, birthday disclosure, advice not to escape—and asks whether something is concealed.
counterevidence_and_limits: The list does not give her the full operational plan. Denia’s private scenes and the containment document remain reader-side knowledge.
revision_or_falsification_condition: If later material dates full disclosure before this exchange, the knowledge-state account must be revised; absent that, suspicion must not be upgraded to complete knowledge.

title: Her restraint about secrets is conditional, not indifference
support: She permits some continued not-asking but insists on a future birthday. Later she seeks information and directly asks about Nivora’s nonreturn.
counterevidence_and_limits: This is not a blanket doctrine that friends owe nothing or must reveal everything. Different stakes elicit different questions.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Repeated explicit indifference to a friend’s survival or a demand for total access in comparable circumstances would challenge the inferred boundary.

title: A future birthday functions as a concrete claim on continued friendship
support: Instead of resolving every secret, she asks whether Denia will still celebrate next year. Ordinary ritual gives continuity a specific form.
counterevidence_and_limits: The promise is not proof of fulfillment and does not settle Denia’s fate. Calling it a claim is interpretive, not a legal or absolute moral right.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Evidence that Sigrika intended the question as a casual pleasantry rather than concern would weaken the reading; the unusual-behavior prelude currently argues against that.

title: Later hope is compatible with grief and explicit bad news
support: She directly seeks confirmation, remembers the outing, reports a letter, and continues working toward a future. The summary frames acceptance rather than total forgetting.
counterevidence_and_limits: The complete letter is not shown in the inspected scene, and a promised return is not observed. Hope must not be redescribed as certainty.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A later primary account can revise her knowledge or coping. Sustained denial of the explicit nonreturn would challenge this state model.

title: She does not know every truth the reader learns about the white bird
support: Her excitement and taxonomy are separated from a private Hiyuki-related explanation. The latter is not a line she automatically hears.
counterevidence_and_limits: It remains possible that she learns more elsewhere; the current selection does not establish when.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A located disclosure scene would advance her knowledge state. Until then, generated predictions must preserve the asymmetry.

title: Denia’s protective framing cannot exhaust Sigrika’s personhood
scope: Other-person archive versus Sigrika’s direct actions
support: Denia describes innocence punished by a cruel world, but Sigrika decides, notices, questions, and contributes. Her friend’s compassion is important but perspectival.
counterevidence_and_limits: Sigrika is genuinely vulnerable to manipulation and pressure. Rejecting reduction to innocence is not denial of victimization.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A broader corpus could show some perceived agency was engineered; particular decisions would then require reassessment, not automatic transfer of all authorship to others.

title: Lynae is both a recipient of expertise and a route into shared leisure
support: Sigrika helps with coursework and values Lynae’s color, spontaneity, and play. Their relationship cannot be flattened to competent rescuer and passive patient.
counterevidence_and_limits: The evidence does not establish complete reciprocity in every domain or a uniform equality of need.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Primary interactions that contradict a specific tutoring or leisure claim should correct that claim; broader asymmetries may refine the relationship profile.

title: Adult help is not limited to telling her to try harder
scope: Examination, counseling, safety decisions, and teaching
support: Adults name the burden, offer counseling, provide protection, and sometimes recognize a self-made decision. Their responses differ and can change.
counterevidence_and_limits: They do not always find the perfect formulation, and institutional recognition can add pressure. This is not an idealized faculty portrait.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A source showing that a claimed supportive act was coercive under omitted conditions would require local revision.

title: Her later life preserves learning deficits without making recovery a failure
support: She still needs scientific help and can learn games from Rebecca while offering rune or cultural knowledge in return. Agency improves without universal competence.
counterevidence_and_limits: Learning itself can improve actual skill. The model must not fossilize an early limitation into permanent inability.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Evidence of newly mastered specific subjects updates capabilities; it need not refute the distinction between psychological change and omniscience.

title: Her public competence and private self-address are different behavioral layers
scope: Institutional praise, diary, and direct recovery
support: She can sound helpful and capable while privately fearing failure and invoking her own name as a standard. Later private writing provides a separate check on public claims.
counterevidence_and_limits: The gap is not proof of a fabricated public persona or a secret cynical self. Both layers can be sincere.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A source explicitly identifying systematic insincere public performance would require adding that mechanism rather than presuming it from distress.

title: Self-naming turns a social identity into an inward instruction
support: The formulation because I am Sigrika transforms a name into an obligation. Later self-address can also register pride and happiness after chosen action.
counterevidence_and_limits: Self-address is not itself pathological or uniquely diagnostic. Its content and state, not mere occurrence, carry the interpretation.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A corrected speaker or diary attribution would require withdrawal of the relevant instance; additional playful self-address would expand the range rather than negate it.

title: Speech shifts by recipient and circumstance
scope: Archive, family, peers, authority, and counterpart
support: Technical explanation, warm family reassurance, peer teasing, anxious self-correction, and direct refusal use different forms. Senior address does not imply identical behavior with every senior.
counterevidence_and_limits: Without listening, punctuation and wording cannot establish prosody, vocal warmth, breathiness, or actor intent.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Acquired matched AV could refine performance claims. It should not overwrite the textual recipient distinctions without considering localization and editing.

title: Gold is valuable and burdensome at once
support: Expectations are described as bright, warm, and heavy; domestic objects repeat warmth and weight. The solution preserves value while changing how it is carried.
counterevidence_and_limits: Not every gold-colored prop has been seen, and not every warm object must be interpreted as the same metaphor. The photo scene warns against overreach.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A source framing the decisive change as rejection of all affection would contradict this account; merely showing a visually gold object would not substantiate it.

title: Meaning is relational without granting her universal interpretive authority
scope: Rune explanation, childhood stars, and interpersonal limits
support: The archive describes finding relations that disclose meaning; interpersonal scenes show she can interpret but cannot define another person completely.
counterevidence_and_limits: Extending rune vocabulary into an ethics of interpretation is an analytical synthesis, not an explicit philosophical treatise by Sigrika.
revision_or_falsification_condition: If future text rejects the connection or portrays her consistently claiming final authority over others, the synthesis should narrow. Technical rune success alone cannot confirm it.

title: Unknown civilization remains unknown
support: She reports projections and unanswered questions; her speculation that runes may read her is marked as a question.
counterevidence_and_limits: The source may permit hypotheses about engineering or ancient origins. None becomes a verified identity in this dossier.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A later explicit primary identification can close part of the gap. An English True Name label or gameplay description is not sufficient evidence by itself.

title: Menu-triggered growth and defeat lines are not dated longitudinal observations
support: The same archive contains reassurance, later resolve, growth language, battle exclamations, and defeat triggers. Their coexistence does not demonstrate a chronological relapse or canonical death.
counterevidence_and_limits: Triggered lines remain useful for repertoire and production framing when correctly typed.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A story scene explicitly reusing a line at a known time can supply a new chronological occurrence; it must be separately located.

title: The selected body of evidence supports a bounded reconstruction, not a complete game-wide biography
support: The contextual selection, unresolved identities, summary-only aurora-flight reference, and incomplete full-quest graph boundary are explicit.
counterevidence_and_limits: The large and coherent central corpus is sufficient for substantial characterization; acknowledging gaps is not treating every claim as equally uncertain.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Acquisition of missing primary sequences should extend the reconstruction and test its predictions rather than retroactively pretend those sequences were read here.

title: Actual waveform analysis now supports bounded machine-voice profiling
scope: Acquired native audio and declared signal methods in V0.2
support: All 2,809 routed objects were acquired, decoded, and FLAC/native-PCM verified; direct and counterpart scopes are separate. New pitch, energy/timing, spectral, normalization, source-context, quality, and sensitivity analyses support machine_voice_profiled under explicit limits.
counterevidence_and_limits: Only 2,531 of 2,652 direct objects pass the principal pitch gate. No word alignment, isolated-stem guarantee, direct perceptual listening, or video review is claimed. Machine completion does not imply human-performance or audiovisual completion.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A route, hash, reproducibility, or material method failure reopens the affected result and completion scope. A later perceptual or video pass may revise a specific interpretation without erasing verified signal measurements.

title: Cross-language timing differences are not automatically acting differences
scope: Localized semantics and acquired waveform evidence
support: Meaning, tense, line length, and runtime variant can differ. The packet therefore checks important wording shifts before proposing performance comparisons. V0.2 adds actual same-semantic recordings, language-specific written-unit duration controls, and explicit counterexamples to universal delivery assumptions.
counterevidence_and_limits: Matched semantics do not eliminate all production or mix differences. A clean comparison still needs equivalent circumstances and media inspection.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Only suitably matched acquired media and controlled analysis can support a particular acting contrast; a longer file alone cannot.

title: No visual-performance conclusion is established by this packet
support: No Sigrika image/video witness was acquired, and toolkit code is not character evidence. Source descriptions of pictures or actions remain textual evidence.
counterevidence_and_limits: The AV plan identifies strong visual tests; lack of a witness does not imply no expressive design exists.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Acquired and actually inspected frames/sequences with declared clocks and provenance can support scoped visual claims. Tool installation or synthetic tests cannot.

title: Sigrika’s ordinary future is more than restored usefulness
support: Rest, shared pictures, food, fuller conversation, stories brought home, and desired journeys coexist with continued work. They are ends she can value, not merely fuel for tasks.
counterevidence_and_limits: Work remains meaningful to her; a fulfilling day is not necessarily an escape from contribution. Some English wording stresses productivity more than the Chinese.
revision_or_falsification_condition: An explicit later rejection of these desires as worthless except for work would challenge this account. Continuing to volunteer does not by itself do so.

title: The model’s central distinction predicts both refusal and voluntary commitment
support: A request can be declined when unmanageable, accepted when she can meaningfully contribute, or renegotiated when it conflicts with friendship. The governing change is not a binary from obedience to refusal.
counterevidence_and_limits: The ordering is qualitative, not a fitted probability model. Very high-stakes novel cases remain uncertain.
revision_or_falsification_condition: Repeated primary decisions contrary to the proposed distinctions would require revising the priority rules rather than explaining every miss as an exception.

title: Contradictions should be retained at the level where the evidence places them
support: Care and pressure, effort and rest, perception and incomplete knowledge, playful overstepping and respect for secrets, and hope and grief are all evidenced without requiring a perfectly consistent ideal self.
counterevidence_and_limits: Not every inconsistency is profound character design: some are localization, chronology, source-class, or extraction differences. Those explanations must be checked first.
revision_or_falsification_condition: A contradiction dissolved by an exact source correction should be removed, not preserved for rhetorical richness. Genuine unresolved tensions remain explicit.
